g.text: Paired seed effects | optimizer policy interaction

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #333333

g.text: H and absolute G answer different questions; a positive H alone does not prove positive depth benefit
Exploratory control on an already observed tune cohort; Case-to-patient mapping unverified; no clinical validation.
Five paired seeds; means are not ensembles; sample SD is not a confidence interval. Frozen features; no augmentation.
Policies share the full prefix state and sampled views. Final update 3,200 fixed; four steps use more compute.
10 prefixes x 2,560 + 20 tails x 640 = 38,400 actual new updates. Constant branches exactly replay the original fits.
